name: Makemake
tagline: The Rapa Nui creator's world — a methane-frosted dwarf at the Kuiper belt's cold edge.

facts.label: Surface
facts.value: Methane and ethane ice, red tholin frost

history: Makemake — named for the Rapa Nui creator god — is the second-brightest Kuiper belt object after Pluto. Its surface is coated in methane ice reddened by solar radiation into tholin frost, and it holds enough gas for a thin seasonal atmosphere when closest to the Sun. A small dark moon was found in 2016 Hubble imagery. With an orbit carrying it from 38 to 53 AU, Makemake spends centuries farther out than Neptune ever ventures.
